reviews.title: Add a loop option for pomodoro timer auto start
reviews.text: There needs to be an update on the pomodoro timers and maybe even add a countdown timer for the next update I would love to have a loop option to loop both the pomodoro timer and breaks if you are going to have them auto start when I swipe to it I paid premium and think it would be very useful for it to be added so then I can use it more

reviews.title: Great but
reviews.text: This is an amazing app for studying but sometimes when I study it just resets which I find very annoying and frustrating but overall it’s pretty good

reviews.title: Pointless
reviews.text: Unless I’m doing it wrong, I need this clock to show the time without having to tap the widget

reviews.title: Stop asking for a review
reviews.text: What’s the point in trying to use this app as a pomodoro timer if it keeps stopping the timer to ask for a review? I even got premium because I thought it would reduce the interruptions. Instead, I have to manually restart the timer every time because it continually begs for a review. So here you go, here’s your review.
